description: Unit tests for rbus element handling, including element retrieval, insertion, deletion, and table row management, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: isElementValid
methods.description: Checks if an element's fullName matches the expected fullName.

methods.name: testRetrieveElement
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an element by query and compares its fullName.

methods.name: testRetrieveInstanceElement
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an instance element by query and compares its fullName.

methods.name: insertElem
methods.description: Inserts an element into the element tree at specified path and type.

methods.name: removeElem
methods.description: Removes an element from the tree at specified path.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a row to a table element at specified path.

methods.name: delRow
methods.description: Deletes a row from a table element at specified path.

methods.name: printRow
methods.description: Prints the registered elements in the tree to memory stream.
